resumo.en: Art direction and animation for the opening, lower thirds and transitions of Desenrola aí, a political podcast on YouTube.

desafio.en:
Desenrola aí is a YouTube podcast that debates politics and society for a progressive audience from Brazil's urban peripheries. Maxuel Mello directs and edits it, and he needed the show to look like one: an opening, lower thirds and transitions he could drop into every episode.

The catch was time. The package had to be ready fast and keep working, episode after episode.

processo.en:
I went with collage: cut-out paper and images, assembled like a poster. Cut-outs are quick to make and quick to animate, which mattered on this deadline. So I built one library of cut-outs first and pulled every piece from it. The same shapes open the show, carry names and topics in the lower thirds, and wipe between segments.

One library, three uses. It kept the package consistent and let me move fast. I timed the opening to its own track. Even the show's name assembles itself on screen from the same scraps.

resultado.en: An opening cut to its own track, plus lower thirds and transitions, all built from one cut-out library. The package still runs in the channel's episodes today, and Maxuel drops it into each new one himself. Made in two weeks, in 2023.
